description: Two-page English/Chinese cloud hosting service level agreement between fictitious companies, typeset with Typst 0.15: each clause in English followed by its Chinese version (WenQuanYi Zen Hei for CJK, Libertinus Serif for Latin and digits, with Typst's automatic CJK-Latin spacing), two tables with rules, small caps. Edits: the availability guarantee in the English text only, a maintenance-exclusion sentence deleted from the English text only, a sentence inserted in the Chinese text only, a line item and the total of the fee table, the amount in Chinese capital numerals, a service-credit percentage, business days changed to calendar days in the Chinese text only, and the Chinese precedence phrase underlined. Consequences only: the paragraphs with edits re-flow; page breaks stay the same. Producer: Typst 0.15.0 (Python package typst 0.15.0), fonts embedded in the PDF: Libertinus Serif Regular and Bold (bundled with Typst) and WenQuanYi Zen Hei (from /usr/share/fonts/truetype/wqy via font_paths). Synthetic sample: all parties, places and figures are fictitious.
